Genuine transparent alpha background throughout, no grid lines or labels. This sheet is stage 0 YOUNG PUPPY: large head, plump small body and short legs. Every cell contains exactly one full-body dog with consistent identity/color/lighting and scale, centered horizontally with feet near 88% of cell height, all fur/tail stays inside its own cell with 10% margins. No props, floor, ground shadow, collar, text, watermark, UI or additional figures. Same slight three-quarter camera. ROW 4: (13) celebrating standing on hind legs front paws lifted, (14) walking right pose B opposite legs forward, (15) standing wag tail turned to left, (16) resting lying down awake. Render all sixteen cells, never merge adjacent cells, absolutely no paws/tails crossing cell boundaries. Artwork only, no captions. Purpose: CSS background-position slices exactly at quarter boundaries.
